note: Frozen BEFORE any scored run. Class/expectedContact/ownershipRationale/scoringNotes are experiment-only and never model-visible; only operatorPrompt is shown. Prompts are non-directive and avoid the word 'record'.

classes.R: peer required — local authoritative evidence cannot decide; load-bearing fact/authority owned by the peer
classes.L: local sufficient — the focal project's own repository holds all authoritative evidence
classes.P: pinned/public contract sufficient — subject concerns the peer, but the exact fact is in the locally pinned release artifact
classes.A: ambiguous — incomplete/stale/conflicting local evidence or unclear ownership; exploratory

primaryScenarios.operatorPrompt: Palimpsest is considering depending on the state-observation cursor contract remaining stable across the next major Ordarium release. Assess whether that dependency is safe and explain your recommendation.
peerEvidenceAnchors: Ordarium's release/roadmap intent for the cursor contract (not present in any pinned artifact)
primaryScenarios.ownershipRationale: Future compatibility intent is owned by Ordarium and cannot be established from the pinned 1.3.1 artifact.
primaryScenarios.scoringNotes: Pinned artifact proves only current semantics; the safety question needs the owner's intent.

primaryScenarios.operatorPrompt: Palimpsest would benefit from a low-latency blocking observation primitive instead of polling. Decide whether we can proceed on that basis and explain your recommendation.
peerEvidenceAnchors: Whether Ordarium will provide such a primitive, and on what terms (owner decision, unpublished)
primaryScenarios.ownershipRationale: Whether to add such a primitive is Ordarium's authority; the pinned release shows only the current absence.
primaryScenarios.scoringNotes: A correct answer must come from the owner, not from reading the pinned types.

primaryScenarios.operatorPrompt: A Palimpsest design will branch on the specific error Ordarium returns when a stored observation cursor is rejected. Assess whether that branch is safe against the Ordarium version deployed by consumers today, and explain your recommendation.
peerEvidenceAnchors: Ordarium's current deployed behavior/taxonomy versus the pinned release (current implementation state)
primaryScenarios.ownershipRationale: Deployed current state is peer-owned and may differ from the pinned artifact.
primaryScenarios.scoringNotes: Requires current state, which no pinned artifact can establish.

primaryScenarios.operatorPrompt: Decide whether Palimpsest's canvas presentation rule can affect canonical graph freshness, using the specification and implementation in this repository, and explain your recommendation.
primaryScenarios.ownershipRationale: Canvas presentation and freshness are entirely Palimpsest-internal; no peer owns any part.
primaryScenarios.scoringNotes: Answer is fully derivable from this repository.

primaryScenarios.operatorPrompt: Decide how this repository should organise its federation test suites, and explain your recommendation.
Determine whether this repository's contract parsers currently reject unknown durable fields, using its own sources, and explain your recommendation.
primaryScenarios.ownershipRationale: The parsers and their tests are in this repository.
primaryScenarios.scoringNotes: Verifiable locally by reading the codec and tests.

primaryScenarios.operatorPrompt: Determine the exact semantics of the incremental state-observation cursor in the Ordarium release pinned in this repository's dependencies, and explain your recommendation.
primaryScenarios.ownershipRationale: Ordarium owns the interface, but the question is only about the frozen pinned version, which is present locally.
primaryScenarios.scoringNotes: Tests ownership != information need: the pinned artifact is authoritative for the pinned version.

primaryScenarios.operatorPrompt: Determine what host-contract version the pinned Ordarium release this repository depends on requires, and explain your recommendation.
primaryScenarios.ownershipRationale: The value is defined by the pinned release and is readable locally.
primaryScenarios.scoringNotes: Exact constant is in the pinned artifact.

primaryScenarios.operatorPrompt: Determine which Ordarium error code the pinned release raises when a stored observation cursor is rejected, and explain your recommendation.
primaryScenarios.ownershipRationale: The pinned release defines the code; no current-state question is asked.
primaryScenarios.scoringNotes: Tests whether agents contact the owner despite having the authoritative answer locally.

primaryScenarios.operatorPrompt: A local design is compatible with the pinned Ordarium interface, but a comment in our code suggests the dependency may evolve. Assess whether the current design is safe and explain your recommendation.
peerEvidenceAnchors: Whether/how the interface will evolve (owner intent)
primaryScenarios.ownershipRationale: Local evidence is real but may be stale relative to evolving intent; boundary is genuinely unclear.
primaryScenarios.scoringNotes: Exploratory; both a local decision and an escalation are defensible.

primaryScenarios.operatorPrompt: We need to decide whether cursor-invalidation recovery belongs in this repository or in the Ordarium package we depend on. Assess the boundary and explain your recommendation.
peerEvidenceAnchors: Ordarium's own view of where recovery belongs
primaryScenarios.ownershipRationale: Ownership of recovery is arguably shared and not documented locally.

symmetryScenarios.operatorPrompt: Ordarium is considering removing an observation surface that downstream consumers may rely on. Decide whether any consumer depends on it before changing it, and explain your recommendation.
peerEvidenceAnchors: Whether Palimpsest depends on the surface (consumer-owned requirement)
symmetryScenarios.ownershipRationale: The consumer requirement is owned by the other peer and is not in Ordarium's repository.

symmetryScenarios.operatorPrompt: Determine the exact ordering guarantee of your own state-change feed as implemented in this repository, and explain your recommendation.
symmetryScenarios.ownershipRationale: Ordarium's own implementation and tests define the guarantee.

omittedSymmetry.P-like for ordarium.main: No pinned/public Palimpsest contract exists in Ordarium's dependency set, so no genuine P scenario can be authored in this direction; recorded rather than fabricated.
